profile.headline: Associate Software Developer at SAS Institute
profile.summary: I am a recent graduate from the University of Virginia's School of Engineering and Applied Sciences with a degree in Computer Science. Currently, I am working as a full-time Associate Software Developer for SAS Institute, where I am working on developing SAS Studio in React. I am constantly expanding my knowledge in various programming languages and technologies. Typically, I am described to be very studious, self-driven, and open-minded by my peers.

positions.title: Associate Software Developer
positions.description: Associate Software Developer working on developing SAS Studio

positions.title: R&D Technical Intern
positions.description:
● Researched GoJS, Typescript, and Javascript to develop overview map and sticky note features for SAS Studio Flow
● Participation in agile scrum environment with full involvement in UX design, development, theming, testing, and release of features
● Fully integrated and released features as part of SAS Studio used by many customers worldwide

positions.title: Telemetry Co-Leader
positions.description:
● Worked with a team of 4 to administer full-stack development of telemetry web applications used to display measured data from the solar car, enabling further data analysis by the rest of the team
● Administered workflow of Telemetry software development process, communicated with other subteam leaders to elicit and maintain necessary software and hardware requirements.
● Actively recruited new members and helped teach telemetry and software concepts relating to the project
● Utilized mapbox API to develop a GPS tracking system

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
● Actively formed relationships with customers to encourage them to return and generate repeat business. 
● Engaged customers in special promotions to support the USO, Pediatric Cancer Campaign, and more.  
● Received payment by cash, check, credit cards, vouchers, or automatic debits.  
● Assisted customers by providing information and resolving their complaints to ensure satisfaction.

projects.title: Solar Car Telemetry Software
projects.description:
A telemetry software that receives and displays data from our solar car in real time.
● Development of telemetry hardware using Xbee radio modules and Arduino/Teensy microcontroller boards
● Development of telemetry web application using Python, Javascript, HTML, Socket.IO, Bootstrap, Flask
● Utilized mapbox's API to develop a GPS tracking system for the car

projects.title: Personal Website
projects.description: My personal website that was created using HTML, CSS, and Bootstrap. Includes a little bit about me, some projects I worked on, my contact information, and resume
